hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: All values must share the identical remainder when divided by step increment k.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If distinct remainders exist modulo k, it is impossible to equalize the array.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Divide differences by k and align elements to their median value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting quotients to determine median distance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-median targets yields strictly suboptimal distance sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Validates modulo congruence and minimizes L1 distance via median.
